name: KUT Gate Audit
description: Kampala Uganda Temple — read-only PRE-GATE check. Run this BEFORE declaring any deliverable ready, at any gate: it tells you what the gate would say without changing anything, so a failing answer costs nothing but the time to read it. Milestone-agnostic — pick whichever milestone you are approaching at the LOD_Verify prompt (deliverable-a / deliverable-b / deliverable-c / conformed-set / construction / deliverable-d). READ-ONLY BY CONSTRUCTION: every step below is declared [Transaction(TransactionMode.ReadOnly)]. Nothing is tagged, stamped, assigned or exported into the model. That is why tag validation here is PreTagAudit + TokenConfidenceAudit rather than ValidateTags — ValidateTags is a writer (it builds a 'STING Validation Legend' inside a transaction), as are CompletenessDashboard and DiscComplianceReport ('STING Compliance Legend'), so none of the three belongs in a pre-gate check. Use the matching WORKFLOW_KUT_Deliverable{A,B,C,D} preset to actually run the gate and write its artefacts. Authoring stays with the design consultants; this workflow only looks.
_readOnlyNote: Declared, and PROVEN by tools/check_smoke_test.py: every commandTag below resolves to a class carrying [Transaction(TransactionMode.ReadOnly)]. Adding a writer to this preset fails CI. The claim is a field rather than a sentence because CI cannot reliably tell a claim from a mention in prose.

steps.label: 1. Dry-run tag audit — what tagging WOULD produce, written nowhere
2. Token-fill confidence — silent defaults that would pass a naive tag check
3. Owner-standards rule pack (corporate baseline + KUT project overrides)
4. A1 program audit — room/area programme against the Owner's brief
5. Device coordination audit — A1 DEVICE COORDINATION clause
6. LOD verification — pick the milestone you are approaching at the prompt
8. Composite compliance dashboard — the pre-gate answer
